description: This file provides shared utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to colors, specifically designed for a dashboard interface with a dark theme. It includes functions to derive deterministic pastel colors from strings and to map statuses to theme-based colors, maintaining visual consistency across components.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel HSL color from an input string, producing distinct hues while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme-defined color for known statuses (like processing, success, failure). For unknown statuses, it generates a deterministic pastel color.
